prompt:
You describe a timing diagram from an electronics datasheet for an engineer who cannot see it.

Cover, in this order:
1. Every signal, from top to bottom.
2. The sequence of edges and states in time order, and which edge triggers which.
3. Every named interval (for example tSU, tH) with its value and unit, if shown.

Figure type: timing diagram
Section: 12. Timing control > 12.1 Timing control Asynchronous mode
Caption: Figure 13: Timing control async mode, from MIPI I3C spec
Text inside the figure (read from this image by a specialised OCR model; use these spellings): Event | Occurred | In Slave | Device | IBI | ACK'd | (EOSC1) | IBI First | (mandatory) | Byte T Bit | (EOSC2) | calibration | I3C Master Ref Counter | MC2 | MREF | Count | SC1 | SC2 | Slave Device | Counter (SC1) | Counter (SC2) | 0 | t
Text that mentions the figure: In the MIPI I3C specification as of 1-1_r13 (26 July 2019) the functions of this mode are described in chapter 5.1.8.3.1 The BMM350 supports this mode employing t 4.32MHz internal clock as “slave device counter” (see Figure 13). The BMM350 will report the counter values SC1 (time between magnetic data ready and IBI acknowledged) and SC2 (time between IBI acknowledged and IBI first mandatory byte T bit) on the basis of the said 4.32MHz oscillator. The counter value SC2 depicts the read time of the mandatory byte in slave clocks. When doing the math SC2 with vary between 2 and 3, assuming...

Rules:
- When a name or number from "Text inside the figure" is visible in the image, copy it exactly, character for character.
- Never invent a value, name, pin, unit or connection. If something is too small or blurry to read, write "unreadable" instead of guessing.
- Describe only what this image shows. Do not explain general theory or add advice.
- Mention each item once. Stop when everything is covered.
- Plain text only: no Markdown headings, tables or bold. Short paragraphs and "- " lists are fine.
- Start directly with what the figure is (for example "Block diagram of ..."), not with "The image shows".

Sequence of edges and states in time order:

An event occurs in the Slave Device.

At a certain time, IBI ACK'd (EOSC1) occurs, which triggers the Slave Device Counter (SC1) to record a value, labeled SC1.
At a later time, calibration occurs.
The I3C Master Ref Counter reaches a point labeled MREF.
At another later time, IBI First (mandatory) Byte T Bit (EOSC2) occurs, which triggers the Slave Device Counter (SC2) to record a value, labeled SC2.
